description: Imperial Limited, formerly Imperial Sugar Limited, was incorporated in Pakistan on 9 May 2007 and is quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its principal line of business is investment management: buying, selling, holding or otherwise acquiring and investing the company's capital in financial instruments, without acting as an investment or brokerage company. Its own site describes it as also venturing into vertical farming and housing development, with pilot projects under way.
headOffice: Ismail Aiwan-e-Science Building, 205 Ferozepur Road, Lahore 54600, Pakistan
